title: Hanford's Central Plateau water facility passes acceptance testing and enters service
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports that the Central Plateau Water Treatment Facility passed all operational acceptance testing and now provides potable water to the site's cleanup hub and tank-waste operations. Denominator: The named 10,000-square-foot water-treatment facility and its accepted potable-water service to Hanford's Central Plateau; 3.5 million gallons per day is stated capability, not observed period throughput.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports that the Central Plateau Water Treatment Facility passed all operational acceptance testing and now provides potable water to the site's cleanup hub and tank-waste operations.
